title: Sum of K Subarrays With Length at Least M
summary: Given an integer array nums and two integers k and m, find the maximum sum of k non-overlapping subarrays, each with a length of at least m.
statement: Given an integer array nums and two integers k and m, find the maximum sum of k non-overlapping subarrays, each with a length of at least m.
constraints: nums is nonempty and k*m <= len(nums).
Choose exactly k pairwise non-overlapping contiguous subarrays, each of length at least m.
hints: Prefix sums turn a subarray contribution into prefix[end] plus a best prior boundary value.
Build one DP layer per selected subarray while maintaining the best eligible start as the end advances.
Carry the skip value; once end reaches m, add previous[start]-prefix[start] to the running start maximum and compare taking.
Each transition ends the newest subarray after all earlier selections, which enforces non-overlap and covers every length at least m.
editorial: Each transition ends the newest subarray after all earlier selections, which enforces non-overlap and covers every length at least m.

tests.explanation: Choosing [1,2] and [3,3,4] produces the optimal sum thirteen.
The only way to fit two length-two subarrays uses the whole array, totaling ten.
